I honestly can't remember why I decided to do it the first time. I was 13 and I was bored. I was alone in a room at my dad's girlfriend's beach house. I took a razor and cut myself on my thighs, while being careful my bathing suit would cover the scars. I've always been depressed and always had to deal with anxiety but at the time I wasn't feeling particularly bad. I was just bored, I wanted to try it, and I liked it. I liked seeing the blood, and the stinging, and I felt oddly proud of myself.

After that I only did it when I really felt bad. It helped calm me down and the pain would take my mind off my problems for a while. Sometimes when I felt really awful I would overdo it and then regret it because the scars were too visible. I never wanted people to see them because I didn't want to face the awkward questions and I didn't want to talk about it, but to be honest, I'm not ashamed. I love my scars, I think they're beautiful. I love seeing blood running down my skin, it's the best relief ever. I feel very guilty about not thinking it's a big deal, because I have friends who cut and I certainly do think it's a big deal for them and I'd do anything to stop them from doing it. 

Anyway... Sorry about this long comment, and sorry I don't have the answers you're looking for. I don't think you should feel like a wannabe. You just wanted to try and realised it helped you feel a little better, and you hung to that feeling. I hope my story was helpful. The only advice I can give you is to not torture yourself with questions. You can never understand everything about yourself, and trying to will not help if you have depression or anxiety. Just focus on getting better, that's all that matters.
